There are two types of double plastic surgery methods: burial method and incision method.

The surgical technique of double plastic surgery isburial methodandincision methodIt is divided into two types.

Since the characteristics and the condition of the eyelids that are suitable for each surgical method differ, if you choose a method that is not suitable for you, you may misunderstand the results.

of the eyelidsThickness, amount of fat, degree of sagging skinThe appropriate surgical method varies depending on the patient, so it is important to explain your current condition to the doctor in detail during counseling.

How to choose a surgical method based on eyelid condition
    • Burial method: A surgical method that is easy to consider for those who want to reduce downtime.
    • Incision method: This surgical method may be considered for those who have thick eyelids or who are concerned about sagging skin.

Understanding the characteristics of each will make it easier to understand what will be explained during counseling and will make it easier to consider the options that suit you.

The burial method is a surgical method that is easy to consider for those who want to reduce downtime.

The burial method means that the eyelid skin andtarsal plateThis is a surgical method in which the cartilage-like tissue on the inside of the eyelid is secured with medical thread to form a double line.

There are two types of fixation methods, and the duration differs depending on the method of fixation.

It is a surgical method that does not use a scalpel, and the treatment time is for both eyes.Around 30 minutesis considered a guideline.

The degree of swelling varies from person to person, but it may reach its peak around 2 to 3 days after surgery and subside within about a week.

People who are suitable for the burial method and people who are not suitable for it
  • person for: Thin eyelid skin and little fat / Desiring a natural double eyelid width / Considering changing the eyelid width in the future
  • Not suitable for people: Thick eyelid skin, a lot of fat, noticeable sagging skin/Wish for a wide range of eyelid designs

If the eyelid skin is thick or has a lot of fat, it may be difficult to maintain the line with just fixation with threads, and the line may change over time.

However, the burial method is not a permanent procedure.

First, with the burial method, the surgery time is short and the swelling only takes about a week.
On the other hand, the fixation force is somewhat weak, and you may return to a single eyelid.
People with thick skin or who have a lot of fat on their eyelids tend to have a tendency to return.

Quote:Double eyelid surgery (double eyelid surgery) | Japanese Society of Plastic Surgery

This is an easy procedure to consider for people whose eyelid skin is relatively thin and has little fat, or for those who want a natural-looking double eyelid.

Also, if you want to change the width in the future,I want to leave options to get closer to the original state.It may also be considered in some cases.

The incision method may be considered for people with thick eyelids or those who are concerned about sagging skin.

The incision method is a surgical method that creates a double eyelid line by making an incision in the skin of the eyelid.

This is a method of creating double lines manually.
In addition to double eyelids, it is also suitable for making the eyes appear larger and improving the balance of the eyes by widening the width of the inner and outer corners of the eyes.

Quote:What is cosmetic surgery? ｜JSAS

Because the line is created by adjusting the skin and internal tissues, one of its characteristics is that the line tends to be maintained more easily than with the burial method.

If your eyelids are thick, have a lot of fat, or if you are concerned about sagging skin, an incision method may be suggested.

Also for incision methodFull incision methodandPartial incision method (small incision)It can be divided into two types.

Downtime tends to be longer than the burial method, and the period during which swelling is most noticeable isAbout 1 to 2 weeksis considered a guideline.

There are individual differences in the time it takes for the finish to stabilize, butApproximately 3 to 6 monthsIt is common to be guided.

Approximate downtime and costs for incision method
  • Period when swelling is most noticeable: About 1 to 2 weeks after surgery
  • Until the finish is stable: about 3 to 6 months
  • Estimated cost in Osaka area: around 200,000 to 400,000 yen for both eyes
  • It may be difficult to return to the original state after surgery

If you are concerned about the impact on your work or daily life, it may be a good idea to consider scheduling your treatment with more leeway, such as scheduling your treatment around a holiday.

With the incision method, it may be difficult to return to the original state after the procedure. Please make your decision after receiving a thorough explanation of the treatment details and risks.

Medicines, materials, and equipment used in free medical treatment for cosmetic purposes may not be approved by law (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Act).
Therefore, listen to your doctor's explanation carefully and understand the safety and effectiveness of the medicines and medical devices used for you, to the extent that you can explain them yourself.

Quote:One more time before undergoing aesthetic medical treatment｜Consumer Affairs Agency

The cost tends to be higher than the burial method, and in the Osaka area it isApproximately 200,000 to 400,000 yenis considered a guideline.

Depending on the condition of the eyelids, incisional methods may be an option, so it is important to compare and consider the characteristics of each surgical method.

Judging only by the displayed price,If additional fees such as anesthesia fees and post-surgery consultation fees are required.There is. Please check the total cost and cost details before signing the contract.

Since this is a surgical method that creates a line through an incision in the eyelid, the procedure is different compared to the burial method, and the results may vary depending on the skill of the doctor.

The incision method is said to be more likely to maintain the line condition for a long period of time than the burial method.

For example, if the burial method is reapplied every few years, the long-term costs may exceed those of the incision method.

Difference between full incision and partial incision
  • full incision: Surgery method that makes an incision on the entire eyelid / May be suggested to people who are concerned about the thickness and sagging of their eyelids
  • partial incision: May not be applicable depending on the surgical method/condition where the incision area is relatively small.

For the incision methodfull incisionandpartial incision, and partial incisions tend to be less expensive than full incisions.

However, the appropriate surgical method varies depending on the condition of the eyelids, soIt is important to make a selection based on the examination results.。

Although the incisional method tends to be more expensive than the burial method, it may be chosen by those who want to consider the surgical method from a long-term perspective.
